design: matched human-AI pairs: model receives ONLY the extracted brief (topic, type, length, structure outline, tone, audience), never the human text; keep-best of up to 3 attempts (temp 0.9/0.6/0.4), corrective retry on length miss; degenerate outputs (<50% of target) discarded; dedupe on content sha256

quality_gate_history.repilot_rounds: 3/10, 5/10, 3/12, 7/12 during prompt/routing iteration; final gate 10/12 (83%) with retry+google token-headroom fix
quality_gate_history.exclusions: google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview dropped (degenerate <100-word outputs on the OpenRouter endpoint even at reasoning effort low); replaced by google/gemini-3.5-flash to preserve the held-out google family

eval_only_boundary: entire google model family + topics with slug-sha256 mod 100 < 15; fixed before generation; NEVER train on eval_only rows

spend_reconciliation.note: session kill mid-bulk lost in-flight cost records (~$0.73, mostly discarded degenerate calls); true spend overshot the $20 cap by ~2.6%. Ledger reconstructed the killed run from bulk.log.
spend_reconciliation.budget_stop: second bulk run stopped itself at the cap before the gemini-3.5-flash block; google-family pairs are therefore thin (16) -- held-out eval relies mainly on the 176 topic-bucket rows
